title: SteamVR cannot see Lighthouse 2.0 base stations
shortDescription: One or both base stations are not visible to SteamVR.
fullDescription: The Valve Index uses Lighthouse 2.0 base stations that emit IR sweeps. When obstructed, improperly aimed, or unpowered, SteamVR reports them as offline and tracking fails.

fixSteps.title: Verify power
fixSteps.instruction: Check LED on each base station is solid green.

fixSteps.title: Enable Bluetooth
fixSteps.instruction: SteamVR Settings > Startup/Shutdown > enable Bluetooth base station management.

whenToCallPro: If base station fan runs but LED is red, RMA via Steam Support.
videoSearchQuery: Valve Index base station not detected

faq.q: Can I use v1 base stations?

title: SteamVR fails to start
shortDescription: SteamVR errors out at startup before detecting hardware.
fullDescription: Startup failures usually indicate USB issues, outdated GPU drivers, or corrupted SteamVR install.

fixSteps.title: Verify integrity
fixSteps.instruction: Right-click SteamVR in Steam > Properties > Installed Files > Verify.

fixSteps.title: Move to USB 3.0 rear port
fixSteps.instruction: Plug headset into a motherboard rear USB 3.0 port.

whenToCallPro: If USB replacement does not resolve.

faq.a: Yes, USB 3.0 required for the cameras and audio.

title: Headset loses positional tracking
shortDescription: IR sweeps from base stations not reaching headset sensors.
fullDescription: Occlusion by cables, furniture, or direct sunlight blinding sensors causes tracking loss. Mirrors reflect IR and confuse lighthouses.

fixSteps.title: Reposition base stations
fixSteps.instruction: Mount at 2m height, angled 30-45 degrees down, opposite corners.

faq.q: Do base stations need line of sight?
faq.a: Yes, they require clear line of sight to the tracked devices.

title: Index controller battery is low
shortDescription: Controller will shut down soon without charging.
fullDescription: Index Knuckles contain internal rechargeable batteries. When degraded, runtime drops from 7 hours to under 2.

fixSteps.title: Charge via USB-C
fixSteps.instruction: Plug into USB-C charger until LED turns green.

whenToCallPro: Battery replacement requires disassembly; Steam Support can RMA.

faq.a: No, soldered. DIY replacement voids warranty.

title: Headset display not detected by GPU
shortDescription: DisplayPort link failure between headset and PC.
fullDescription: Headset display requires a dedicated DisplayPort 1.2 output. Loose connection, DP-to-HDMI adapters, or cable wear cause failures.

fixSteps.title: Reseat DisplayPort
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and firmly reseat DP into GPU.

fixSteps.title: Use direct DP (no adapter)
fixSteps.instruction: Connect directly to DP output on GPU, not mini-DP adapters.

whenToCallPro: If cable replacement does not resolve.

title: Cannot pair base stations to SteamVR
shortDescription: Bluetooth pairing between PC and Lighthouse fails.
fullDescription: SteamVR uses Bluetooth in the headset to sleep and wake base stations. Pairing fails if base stations are on channel conflicts or BT is disabled.

fixSteps.title: Set unique channels
fixSteps.instruction: Use SteamVR's Identify Base Station tool to set channels b and c.

faq.a: Yes, SteamVR supports up to 4 Lighthouse 2.0.

title: BMR speakers crackle or pop
fullDescription: Often a USB bandwidth issue or a loose audio connector inside the headset.

fixSteps.title: Disable USB devices
fixSteps.instruction: SteamVR Settings > Developer > disable USB devices not in use.

faq.a: Avoid hubs; connect directly to motherboard USB 3.0.

title: Knuckles will not pair to headset
shortDescription: Controller blinks but does not connect.
fullDescription: Pairing issues after firmware updates or when swapping controllers between headsets.

faq.a: Yes, via a Vive BT dongle.

title: Headset cable shows intermittent disconnection
shortDescription: Known failure in Index tether cable.
fullDescription: Index cables are a known wear item. Bending near the breakout box or headset end causes intermittent signal loss.

fixSteps.title: Replace cable
fixSteps.instruction: Buy Index cable from Steam and swap via tri-wing screws.

whenToCallPro: If under warranty, Steam will replace free.

title: Play space cannot be set up
shortDescription: Room setup does not save play area.
fullDescription: SteamVR chaperone data may become corrupted, forcing redo of room setup.

fixSteps.title: Re-run Room Setup
fixSteps.instruction: SteamVR > Room Setup > Standing or Room-scale.

faq.a: Yes via third-party tools like OpenVR Advanced Settings.
